Poor experience, spoiled my parents' last night in Vietnam
Nov 2025 • Couples
My parents visited this restaurant on their final evening in Vietnam, and unfortunately, it was a very disappointing experience for them.

While the restaurant is located on the 51st floor with views of the city, the ambiance fell short of expectations - perhaps the view is better during the day. However, the interior lighting was so dim that they had to use their phone flashlights just to read the menu, which made the dining experience quite uncomfortable.

The service issues were significant. They waited over an hour for their food to arrive, which was far too long to be made to wait. When the dishes finally came, the tempura was served cold - a real letdown since tempura should be crispy and hot.

There were also mix-ups with their drink orders. My father specifically requested a non-alcoholic beer but was served a regular beer instead, which we are very upset about as he doesn't drink alcohol. Additionally, the staff brought them some revolting cocktails that they hadn't ordered, and seemed pushy about them accepting the drinks.

Given these issues, my parents asked to speak with the manager. To their credit, management acknowledged the shocking service and didn't charge them anything. However, by that point, my parents decided to leave and find dinner elsewhere as their dining experience at Sorae was ruined.

It's a real shame that this happened on their last night in Vietnam, especially since they'd had such wonderful experiences at other Vietnamese restaurants throughout their trip.

On a positive note, the live violinist was talented and enjoyable to listen to.

Eventually it turned out that the kitchen would close at 9:30pm. When you view the website there are several menus listed on this , these apparently have to be ordered when booking. Very unfortunate and a missed opportunity!
